# DataSkein

> DataSkein is an open-source, local-first browser workspace for exploring CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, Parquet, and read-only DuckDB data without uploading source files.

## Product facts

- Category: local-first data exploration and reproducible analysis
- Runtime: browser with DuckDB-Wasm
- Inputs: CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, NDJSON, Parquet, and read-only DuckDB tables
- Workflow: profile, filter, sort, select columns, join, chart, and export
- Reproducibility: visible ordered recipes plus SQL and HTML export
- Privacy boundary: source files remain in the browser worker
- License: MIT

## Primary links

- Product: https://dataskein.vercel.app/
- App: https://dataskein.vercel.app/app
- Source: https://github.com/arturict/dataskein
